changed_source_assessment.result: Before one unchanged delegation, the wrapper records only terrain/map-ceiling type-presence booleans and integer window counts. It performs no new warmup floating arithmetic, does not mutate the input table, add terrain, repeat a callback or change the underlying move answer. The existing lift alone copies a real input in its declared window. Terrain-less ordinary movement remains valid.

All query modes/profiles share the same fixed warmup and identity order. The existing recent routed-motion criterion is unchanged; eligibility additionally requires the final warmup callback actually carried numeric terrain elevation and map ceiling. Earlier ineligible movers are counted and passed over without alteration. Type presence does not establish the future step or numerical lift acceptance.

The target-only window counters cover the one actual intervening frame, then close before the three queries. They report target step, move and terrain-bearing-move counts. Lift credit still requires the existing real watched move, terrain table and successful numeric ceiling guard; counters do not fabricate a lift or post-lift offer. A remains strict NeedUpdated/test/moving16; B remains real lift, target offer/coherence and changed physical result.

The old zero lifted/refused counters did not identify which prerequisite failed. This change does not retroactively claim missing terrain or any actor/guide cause in that run. New final-warmup eligibility is not a promise that the next real callback remains eligible.

The same real Lua driver is exercised with scripted Engine/Host collaborators: positive-first eligible ordering; earlier terrain-less mover passed over in control/lift/Original; absent terrain unchanged and one delegation; all-ineligible named prelaunch UNREACHED; no-moving old reason; ordinary terrain-less movement still valid; warmup-eligible but window-ineligible zero-lift provenance; real in-window lift credited. These are driver tests, not actual C movement or retail authority.
